description: Source code for audit logging and audit record management in the Mattermost server, including functions for retrieving audits, logging audit records, creating audit records, configuring audit settings, and managing audit log certificates.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing audit logging functionalities.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct handling audit configuration and error handling.

methods.name: GetAudits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audits for a user with a limit.

methods.name: GetAuditsPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audits for a user.

methods.name: LogAuditRec
methods.description: Logs an audit record with default CLI level.

methods.name: LogAuditRecWithLevel
methods.description: Logs an audit record with a specified log level.

methods.name: MakeAuditRecord
methods.description: Creates a new audit record with default values.

methods.name: configureAudit
methods.description: Configures audit settings, including advanced logging and additional configs.

methods.name: onAuditTargetQueueFull
methods.description: Handles scenario when audit queue is full.

methods.name: AddAuditLogCertificate
methods.description: Adds an audit log certificate from uploaded file.
